# Closed tag and nested completion callback

A public instance method accepts one independently declared nominal tag before
its nested completion callback and same result completion. Original tag identity,
nulls, receiver state, callbacks, sentinels, deferred captures and failure order
are checked by frozen callers. Full original Signatures and metadata remain
intact. Owned and SDK declaration configurations execute 56 cases with two
attempts before and after recovery; four independent wrong programs must fail.
